lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple staggered vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters located posterior to the gill slits and dorsal to the pectoral fin attachment. Blobs exhibit a roughly grid-like distribution with varying inter-blob distance of approximately 10-30 pixels.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible, most notably in the mid-flank region, creating anchor points where vertical bands intersect with the horizontal alignment of the primary white blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the mid-upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher pixel values on the superior edge and lower values/shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant horizontal scan-line/interlacing artifacts are present across the entire subject body, creating a serrated effect on the edges of the high-luminance blobs.
